insert into tb_vacation_detail
id,
user_id,
leave_date,
leave_part,
leave_typ,
leave_day,
#{id,jdbcType=INTEGER},
#{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
#{leaveDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
#{leavePart,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
#{leaveTyp,jdbcType=CHAR},
#{leaveDay,jdbcType=DOUBLE},
mapper.update: update tb_attendance a,tb_vacation_detail b set a.all_day=b.leave_typ where b.id=#{id,jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.user_id=b.user_id and b.leave_part='all' and a.check_date=b.leave_date
update tb_attendance a,tb_vacation_detail b set a.mor_day=b.leave_typ where b.id=#{id,jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.user_id=b.user_id and b.leave_part='mor' and a.check_date=b.leave_date
update tb_attendance a,tb_vacation_detail b set a.aft_day=b.leave_typ where b.id=#{id,jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.user_id=b.user_id and b.leave_part='aft' and a.check_date=b.leave_date
mapper.select: select sum(leave_day) leave_day from tb_vacation_detail where id=#{id,jdbcType=INTEGER} group by id

select a.id, a.user_id, a.leave_date, a.leave_part, a.leave_typ, a.leave_day from tb_vacation_detail a inner join tb_vacation b on (a.id=b.id and b.status in ('97','98','99'))
AND a.ID = '${id}'
AND a.USER_ID = '${userId}'
AND a.LEAVE_DATE = '${leaveDate}'
